Summary: Capital-event interpretation: carry the 8-K event class into subject observations and the brief, then extract amount, instrument and counterparty (v1 magnitude INDETERMINATE)
Description: 1) Original intent: a guest can see what capital events were reported for an entity, not only that a filing exists on a date. Today the guest sees capital evidence as source and date only (for example CAPITAL EDGAR_8K 2026-09-02) and all three capital measures read DATA UNAVAILABLE. Rubric item 2 names 'capital activity listed as a count of 8-Ks without the events they report' as a failure condition. Governing record: specs/decision-record-evidence-to-formation-build-order-20261010.md (workstream 2, break 1). 2) Acceptance criteria: STEP A (first, standalone): (a) the event class the 8-K connector already computes from item codes reaches the subject-bound observation and is shown in the guest-facing evidence (for example CAPITAL EDGAR_8K DEBT_ISSUANCE 2026-09-02, with the accession); (b) the class never changes the signal's magnitude, polarity or domain mapping, and no wording implies a cause or consequence. STEP B (after A is accepted): (c) amount, instrument and counterparty are extracted from the primary filing text where the filing states them, each with its accession and the supporting passage; (d) a field the filing does not state, or text KRYL cannot parse, is shown absent with its absence class (b not obtained, a does not exist), never estimated and never inferred; (e) announced, committed, closed and disbursed amounts stay separate quantities, shown only where a source reports them (rubric item 2 decision); (f) capital-event magnitude stays INDETERMINATE in v1 (Founder decision 2026-10-09). BOTH STEPS: (g) a changed, more informative answer for two entities, one registry-resolved and one admitted at runtime; (h) existing suites stay green; (i) no fabricated relationship, magnitude or causal claim; (j) XBRL capital intensity is a separate job and is not built here. 3) Current implementation state: edgar8ksignal.js computes eventClass from item codes (parseItems, classifyEventClass) and sets it on the signal packet (line ~103; meta carries only canonicalId and eventDate). adsubject.js, perceptionread.js and structuralbrief.jsx contain no eventClass reference (grep 2026-10-10), so the class is dropped before the guest-facing result. parseItems reads item codes only; no amount, instrument or counterparty is extracted anywhere. 4) Dependencies: edgar8ksignal.js, edgar8kconnector.js, domaingravity.js pool fields, adsubject.js formationObservations, perceptionread.js, structuralbrief.jsx and structurepanel.jsx rendering; the snapshot ticket (observations are a snapshot field, so step A must keep the observation shape the snapshot will freeze); workstream 3 (capital relationship types, not in this ticket); the filing text route for step B uses the existing /api/edgar-document proxy. Shared-data gate (CLAUDE.md section 2) applies to the signal packet fields before the first edit. Step B depends on what filing text can be parsed reliably; unverified. 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: no. XBRL capital intensity (xbrl-capital-fields-investigation-20261009.md) is separate and not authorized beyond investigation. 6) Maps to the current product model: yes (observations to relationships to formation; rubric item 2; Absence-Is-Signal). Status: prepared 2026-10-10 as Ready; implementation not authorized until the Founder's explicit go.
